title: 12 South 4 Bedroom Trendiest Location!
description:
Enjoy Nashville’s best neighborhood, walkable to famous sights & shops!

Take it all in from our home in the heart of 12 South. Two blocks walk from restaurants & stores. Less than a 5-minute ride to the Gulch, Belmont and Vanderbilt, & less than 10 mins from Broadway, the Ryman, Bridgestone, Nissan and Geodis.

This home is perfect for families and groups. Kid friendly and dog friendly. The backyard has a nice hang out area. 

We've hired a new cleaner to address previous guest issues.

The space
Clean, cozy 4-bedroom house all on one floor. Beds: 1 king, 1 queen, 1 full, 2 twin (trundle). 
On a corner that’s 2 blocks away from the best bars, restaurants and shops in town! This is a super convenient way to enjoy a neighborhood where public parking is a nightmare!l and $20/hour!

Guest access
Guests have access to the entire home with exception of a portion of the backyard, which we use to store our boat.
